items.title: Louis Keppard Interview, 1961-01-19
items.q: he bucked against Malporez in the same band with Malporez on a parade... he bucked Manuel Manez.

ctx.x: Yeah, because I believe, because he used to play with, he bucked against Malporez in the same band with Malporez on a parade. I'll never forget that. It looks like shortly after he left here, that's before he left them here. It might have been before he then, but still, what about? Before he left them here, he was good.
Yeah, he bucked Manuel Manez. Yeah, Manuel could tell you exactly. What about that Boston studio, I wonder? Maybe they had the picture taken.

Maybe they had the picture taken over again. Maybe he had something to do over there too, you know? But of course we only suggestin' about, because I'm just only lookin', because he sent word with a letter and I made a remembering something.
